citations.narrative:
The door surrounds of two enclosures (housing one dog each) in a sheltered housing facility are not being well
maintained. The material adjacent to the right, left, and bottom opening of the doggy door is chewed, frayed, and missing
in some parts. Surfaces that are not well maintained cannot be appropriately cleaned and sanitized. Correct by ensuring
the surfaces of housing facilities be made of materials that allow them to be readily cleaned and sanitized or removed or
replaced when worn or soiled. Correct by: August 1, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
